nom: CHANEL N°1 DE CHANEL Revitalizing Mask

avis.texte: Ive been using this mask for the last 2 years weekly! I love this mask. Its clean and jelly and no irritation to the skin. It makes my skin very soft and rejuvenated! Love this!

This mask ia absolutely amazing. I use this once a week as directed after cleansing, and it makes my skin so soft and refreshed-feeling. It smells great too and does not irritate me, as I am sensitive to heavily-fragranced products. It is a bit pricy, but a little goes a long way, so this should last me for a good while. Will definitely be purchasing a refill when I run out!

It's hard to find a chemical exfoliant that doesn't burn my skin when I wear it. This is one of the few that doesn't. What I like is that it really did help smooth out some texture I had around my nose and chin after about 2-3 uses (over the course of 2 weeks). I noticed the dryness go first then the flakiness after the 3rd use. Love the smell and texture as well!
